notes: oneDNN determinism pair: the 122B greedy nondeterminism this chain had filed against the MoE transfer cache was oneDNN matmul reduction order (DnnlGemmWrapper built its primitive without set_deterministic). It reproduced with no cache configured and under static placement. GGML_SYCL_DETERMINISTIC (default 1) pins it. Rail: 10/10 identical tokens AND logprobs at 122B for cache-on, cache+hybrid and +advise, with byte-identical execution fingerprints; advise-on == advise-off bit for bit, closing the P1 C4 flicker; tiny fixture 8/8. Cost, same binary, attribute off: C1 -15.20%, C2 -8.01%, C3 -14.87% (dets are the slower arm). The pin advances the determinism fix and the hybrid CPU kernel work together as one validated pair.
